title: HF3302 (2017-2018 Regular): Teacher and school staff training in dangerous situations and firearm provision funding provided, and money appropriated.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/90/2018/0/HF/3302/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version (no date in file). Dollar amounts are blank in the bill.

operative_text:
Section 1 (uncoded): $....... in fiscal year 2019 is appropriated to the commissioner of education for grants to school districts to provide firearm simulator training to prepare teachers, staff persons, and other designated persons employed in the school district to respond to dangerous situations in schools.
Section 2 (uncoded): $....... in fiscal year 2019 is appropriated to the commissioner of education for grants to school districts to provide firearms with biometric gun locks to teachers, staff persons, and other designated persons employed in a district school that is a distance of at least three minutes from a law enforcement response to a dangerous situation at the school.
Section 2 (uncoded): A teacher, staff person, or other designated person who receives a firearm must have received firearm training.
